time_contract.entry_time: decision_time with exact M1 open required
time_contract.higher_timeframe_join: latest source bar whose nominal close time is less than or equal to decision_time
time_contract.previous_exact: use prior feature row only when decision_time spacing equals exactly 15 minutes per requested lag
time_contract.gap_behavior: previous state and onset history reset after a non-15-minute gap

definitions.GML1-DISC-EXH-L: ATR percentile >= 0.65, RSI centered <= -0.25, range >= 1 ATR, lower wick fraction >= 0.40
definitions.GML1-DISC-EXH-S: ATR percentile >= 0.65, RSI centered >= 0.25, range >= 1 ATR, upper wick fraction >= 0.40
definitions.GML1-DISC-RECL-L: previous exact distance from prior 50-bar low < 0, current distance >= 0, lower wick >= 0.20, close location >= 0.55
definitions.GML1-DISC-RECL-S: previous exact distance from prior 50-bar high > 0, current distance <= 0, upper wick >= 0.20, close location <= 0.45
definitions.GML1-DISC-CMP-L: previous exact ATR percentile <= 0.40, current range >= 1 ATR, Bollinger close location > 1, positive body, body fraction >= 0.50
definitions.GML1-DISC-CMP-S: previous exact ATR percentile <= 0.40, current range >= 1 ATR, Bollinger close location < 0, negative body, body fraction >= 0.50
definitions.GML1-DISC-BRK-L: previous exact distance from prior 50-bar high < 0 and current >= 0, positive body, body fraction >= 0.55, volume ratio >= 1.10
definitions.GML1-DISC-BRK-S: previous exact distance from prior 50-bar low > 0 and current <= 0, negative body, body fraction >= 0.55, volume ratio >= 1.10
definitions.GML1-DISC-BBR-L: previous exact Bollinger close location < 0, current >= 0, lower wick >= 0.25, close location >= 0.50
definitions.GML1-DISC-BBR-S: previous exact Bollinger close location > 1, current <= 1, upper wick >= 0.25, close location <= 0.50
definitions.GML1-DISC-MOM-L: MACD histogram crosses above zero, signed body >= 0.05 ATR, close location >= 0.55, volume ratio >= 1.10
definitions.GML1-DISC-MOM-S: MACD histogram crosses below zero, signed body <= -0.05 ATR, close location <= 0.45, volume ratio >= 1.10
definitions.GML1-DISC-RSI-L: RSI centered crosses above -0.35 and MACD histogram improves from previous exact bar
definitions.GML1-DISC-RSI-S: RSI centered crosses below 0.35 and MACD histogram declines from previous exact bar

assignment.same_direction_overlap: first matching candidate in candidate_priority wins
